# Was the DoorDash outage on Nov 21 a cyberattack?

**Not established.** Not established. DoorDash has not given a cause or said anything about an attack. People on social media asked if it was a hack, but no one has shown evidence of one.

Incident: DoorDash app and website outage, Nov 21, 2026. Also reported as the DoorDash outage. First published Nov 21, 2026; last updated Nov 21, 2026, 2:54 PM ET.

Picture: DoorDash logo (used for identification; DoorDash is not affiliated with isitahack.com). Image: DoorDash logo, trademark of DoorDash, public domain on Wikimedia Commons (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:DoorDash_Logo.svg).

This is the current answer, not a final verdict.

## The latest

Nov 21, 2026, 2:54 PM ET: **DoorDash marked both status incidents resolved and says a post mortem will be posted later; the cause is still not given.** We read DoorDash's official status page feed directly at www.doordashstatus.com (added as s009, Tier 1). The Drive incident was marked resolved at 1:58 PM ET. The 'Health Degredation' incident was marked resolved at 2:50 PM ET with a note that it ended at 11:51 AM ET; it names only the Merchant - Marketplace Orders component, with impact none. c002 Reported to Confirmed (direct read of the official page, as the Editor-in-Chief asked) and c010 Not established to Confirmed. The Drive API component says 'Post Mortem will be posted later'; c009 stays Not established until one is published. No cyberattack statement, customer figure or link to other outages; c006, c007, c008 and c011 unchanged. Staleness check done: known and not-known lists, who_is_affected, q002, q003 and the checked-not-found note refreshed. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.

## At a glance

- Status: monitoring
- Size: Large. DoorDash is a food-delivery service that many people use daily, and Downdetector logged more than 12,700 reports. DoorDash has not said how many customers were affected, and Downdetector counts reports, not users.
- Who is affected: People who use the DoorDash app or website, mostly in the US, from about 11 AM ET on Saturday, Nov 21, and businesses using DoorDash Drive from 11:30 AM ET. DoorDash marked both status-page incidents resolved by 2:50 PM ET but has not said when the app was fully back for everyone.

| Value | What | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| 12,700+ | Downdetector reports | User-submitted, not customers affected |
| 11:30 AM | First status-page entry (ET) | Drive endpoint errors |
| 11:50 AM | Recovery update (ET) | On the Drive incident |
| 1:58 PM | Drive incident resolved (ET) | Per DoorDash's status page |

### Known so far

- DoorDash's status page showed an increase in errors on its Drive endpoints from 11:30 AM ET on Nov 21 and a recovery update at 11:50 AM ET.
- DoorDash opened a second status-page incident, 'DoorDash Health Degredation', at 11:33 AM ET, tied to its merchant orders component.
- DoorDash marked the Drive incident resolved at 1:58 PM ET and said the second incident ended at 11:51 AM ET.

### Not known yet

- What caused the outage. DoorDash has not said; its status page says a post mortem will be posted later.
- Whether it was a cyberattack. DoorDash has not said either way; the hack idea is only social-media speculation.
- Whether either status-page incident caused the app and website errors, and when the app was fully back for everyone.
- How many customers were affected.

## What we checked and did not find

We looked for these and did not find them as of the latest update (2:54 PM ET, Nov 21).

- A DoorDash post-incident report or statement giving the cause. The status page says a post mortem will be posted later.
- Any DoorDash statement about a cyberattack, in either direction.
- Which incident, if either, caused the app and website errors. The second incident names only a merchant orders component, with impact none.
- Any statement from a regulator, CISA or an outside investigator.
- A number of affected customers. Downdetector counts reports, not people.
- Any claim of responsibility or credible claim of a hack.
- A link to other outages this month.

Some coverage says DoorDash had not acknowledged the outage. DoorDash's status page shows it had.
